questions.prompt: What is the main development described in the article?
options: A new coalition has been created and its rules are now complete.
Existing members have replaced payroll saving with individual transfers.
More employers have joined a savings coalition, while further guidance is planned.
A completed factsheet has allowed all UK workers to join one scheme.
questions.explanationZh: 文章核心是更多雇主加入储蓄联盟，同时相关说明仍在计划中；联盟不是此次才成立。

questions.prompt: What does the figure of over half a million refer to?
options: Workers who have already made their first savings transfer.
Workers who will gain an opportunity to use workplace savings.
Workers who have asked to leave workplace savings schemes.
Workers whose employers have already received the new factsheet.
questions.explanationZh: 该数字是新增获得机会的人数，不是已参加人数或已收到文件的人数。

questions.prompt: What does the announcement say about taking money out of the savings pot?
options: It can be taken out only when the employee changes jobs.
It can be taken out once a year without paying a fee.
It can be taken out after the new factsheet is published.
It can be taken out when needed without paying a fee.
questions.explanationZh: s7明确需要时可随时免费取用，未设置换工作、每年一次或等待文件的条件。

questions.prompt: What is the planned factsheet intended to explain?
options: How payroll savings schemes should work under minimum wage rules.
How workers should divide savings between different bank accounts.
How coalition members should select the next employers to join.
How workers should calculate the interest earned on their savings.
questions.explanationZh: 说明单旨在澄清工资储蓄计划如何符合最低工资规则，不讨论账户分配、成员挑选或利息计算。
